lines.speaker: Harry Potter
lines.text: B. Parkinson wrote this note, so Pansy has something on you. That is why you left the ball so early.
lines.expression: eyes fixed on the parchment, jaw tightening as the name registers

lines.speaker: Draconia Malfoy
lines.text: Hand it back this instant, Potter, or I will make you regret reading a single word. My business with Pansy is mine alone.
lines.expression: hand snatching for the paper, knuckles white, breath sharp and shallow
